intent.outcome: Docs, the AGENTS template, and the master-planner skill use the real CLI flags so agents following them succeed on the first try.

problem.description: Pilot P2/P3/M4/M5/M6/M8: docs and skill use `--type` (CLI wants `--checklist-type`); `--format human` is documented but unimplemented; the AGENTS template carries a stale 'not implemented' banner; command names drift (`idea add` vs `create`); INSTALL.md version stale; `--json @file` undocumented.

out_of_scope: implementing --format human for every command (top-level only)
renaming or removing the --checklist-type flag (keep both names)

acceptance_criteria.description: --type is accepted as a deprecated alias for --checklist-type (with deprecation notice)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: interview_alias.rs tests pass; --type works with deprecation warning on stderr

acceptance_criteria.description: AGENT-READINESS.md contains a format capability matrix listing which commands support --format human today
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: doc grep finds the matrix; spot-check 3 commands [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AGENT-READINESS.md now has Format support matrix table listing all command --format human status

acceptance_criteria.description: AGENTS template regenerated: stale 'not implemented / safe today' banner removed, consistent with AGENT-READINESS
acceptance_criteria.verification: templates AGENTS-TEMPLATE.md has no stale banner
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AGENTS-TEMPLATE.md removed stale 'not implemented / safe today' banners; all --type replaced with --checklist-type

acceptance_criteria.description: Command-name sweep: docs/skill use real names; INSTALL.md version current; --file / --json @file documented in MP-COMMANDS.md and skill
acceptance_criteria.verification: grep for --type and 'idea add' in docs+skill returns only intentional mentions
acceptance_criteria.evidence: SKILL.md: --type-> --checklist-type, --file and --json @- documented; INSTALL.md: v1 RC-> v1.1

acceptance_criteria.description: --format human is either implemented for top-level commands or honestly marked unsupported per the matrix
acceptance_criteria.verification: mp list milestones --format human returns non-JSON or is marked unsupported in the matrix
acceptance_criteria.evidence: format human implemented for list milestones, status, path; matrix honestly marks others as fallback

work_packages.name: CLI flag alignment
work_packages.goal: Make documented flags work: --type alias and top-level --format human

work_packages.name: Doc & skill sweep
work_packages.goal: Align docs, AGENTS template, and master-planner skill to real CLI names and flags

steps.action: interview checklist: accept the legacy --type flag as a deprecated alias for --checklist-type, emitting a deprecation notice
steps.tests: crates/mp/tests/interview_alias.rs: mp interview checklist --type milestone --id 01 succeeds and warns
steps.done_when: Legacy --type flag works as an alias with a deprecation notice

steps.action: Implement --format human for chosen top-level commands (e.g., list milestones, status, path): render non-JSON human-readable output
steps.tests: crates/mp/tests/format_human.rs: mp list milestones --format human and mp status --format human return non-JSON human text
steps.done_when: Selected top-level commands render --format human as non-JSON text

steps.action: Add a format capability matrix to AGENT-READINESS.md listing which commands support --format human today
steps.tests: manual: grep finds the matrix; spot-check 3 commands against actual CLI behavior
steps.done_when: AGENT-READINESS.md has a format capability matrix matching real behavior

steps.action: Regenerate the AGENTS template: remove stale 'not implemented / safe today' banner; align with AGENT-READINESS
steps.tests: manual: template has no stale banner; flags match AGENT-READINESS
steps.done_when: AGENTS-TEMPLATE.md carries no stale banner and matches AGENT-READINESS

steps.action: Command-name and flag sweep across docs and skill: use real names; refresh INSTALL.md version; document --file and --json @file in MP-COMMANDS.md and the skill
steps.tests: manual: grep for --type and 'idea add' in docs+skill returns only intentional mentions
steps.done_when: Docs and skill use real command names; INSTALL version current; --file and --json @file documented

steps.action: Honestly mark the commands where --format human is not implemented as unsupported in the AGENT-READINESS format matrix (coordinate with the matrix step in WP2)
steps.tests: manual: matrix marks unsupported commands consistently with actual CLI behavior
steps.done_when: Commands without --format human are marked unsupported in the matrix, matching real behavior

verification.evidence: All 6 steps done, 5 ACs passed, 7 new tests, full test suite green
